lines.text: Make a question? You ask it!
Many learners say: Can I make you a question?
Better: Can I ask you a question?
Ask! Can I ask you a question?

data.wrong: Can I make you a question?
data.right: Can I ask you a question?

native.tip: En español “hacer una pregunta”, pero en inglés se usa “ask”: “ask a question”.

en.tip: In Spanish “hacer una pregunta”, but in English you “ask” a question.
